title: 面向可持续中小企业的AI代理：绿色ESG评估框架
summary: 提出一种基于AI的框架，用于评估欧洲中小企业的ESG表现。系统利用n8n自动化平台构建可扩展的AI代理，基于专家验证的基线进行自动ESG分类并生成建议，结果与人工输出高度一致，支持欧洲绿色新政。
summary_en: An AI-driven framework for ESG assessment in European SMEs. A scalable agent system built on n8n automates classification and generates recommendations using LLMs, achieving high consistency with human outputs to support the European Green Deal.
